description: Ask for the payment record link of a paid transfer, to share its bank reports. The account owner must confirm the request on the website before the link is shared: until then the caller does not receive it. The owner sees the request on the website and is normally notified by email. Once confirmed, list_pending_access returns the link. Asking again for the same transfer with the same settings returns the open request; with different settings, the new request replaces it. Only the account owner's API keys and connected apps can ask.

show_commentary.description: Show uetr.ai's plain-language explanations on the record. Leave out to keep the current setting.

show_fees.description: Show bank fees on the record. Leave out to keep the current setting.

name: share_payment_record

detail.description: Plain English to pass on to the person behind the request.

status.description: Nothing has taken effect yet: the account owner must confirm the request.

title: Share a payment record
